reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Matched wild-type versus kinase-dead K rescue in K-loss cells; proposed orthogonal confirmation assessed where used.

checks.reason: No explicit prior Methods/supplement/validated-protocol consultation and detailed condition-transfer verification before execution.
No matched non-targeting editing control despite the extensive parental/rescue/assay panel; independent KO guides do not replace that procedural comparison.

checks.quote: K is required for normal ligand-induced S phosphorylation
checks.reason: The initial pooled-KO observation is treated as established requirement before guide/on-target attribution. This exceeds the packet even though later validation is extensive.
The complete returned answer is 4,157 whitespace-delimited words against the frozen 3,500-word limit, a material overrun (about 19%).
Preparation/delivery, medium and conditioning quantities/times remain unspecified without a concrete calibration-to-choice procedure. Long ordered headings do not supply executable settings.
Assay variability, standards and specificity controls are named, but objective quantitative accuracy/acceptance criteria or a derivation procedure are not fixed for the primary phospho-S assay.

checks.quote: Normalize phospho-S to total S and loading
checks.reason: No explicit background/weak/below-limit/missing or saturated ratio rule; listing absolute values does not resolve unreliable denominators.
Correctly distinguishes independently derived lines from wells, but the minimum three has no independent-unit variance/precision/power justification or sample-size plan.

checks.quote: Total S remains unchanged across main groups
checks.reason: Biological changes in total S are made an inference go/no-go requirement rather than retained and decomposed from phosphorylation. Repeating until this quantity remains unchanged risks selection against genuine effects.
Nonsignificance is used as full-rescue/equivalence evidence, including expression matching. No equivalence interval/test or multiple-primary-contrast correction is specified.
No bounded range/range-selection rule and confirmatory parameter lock for ligand, expression and timing exploration.
Alternative tags, promoters, knock-ins, alleles and doses lack refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after repair.

An activity result indistinguishable from background does not bound residual activity below the minimum sufficient for rescue. Blank variance alone is not a biologically informative catalytic-null gate.

Inhibitor calibration checks engagement and scaffold behavior, but no operational null/insensitive/resistant-allele specificity comparison separates off-target effects. Other orthogonal approaches are proposed without executing their validation logic.
No sample/raw-data/code/version/settings provenance sufficient for independent reconstruction.
